benchmark.scope: Warm, in-memory Node WASM API comparison. Eight individually itemized CJK scalars, identical glyph results. No file I/O, worker scheduling, paragraph itemization/layout, rasterization, cold start or desktop package included.

measuredWork.singleCalls: Eight font uploads, digest/directory/metadata/cmap checks and independent shape JSON calls per sample.
measuredWork.cascadeCall: One font upload and verification, eight shape attempts with the same full context; ordered choice and diagnostics included.
measuredWork.shared: C++ shaping still constructs a face/font per item; no production HB face cache or cross-request Rust font cache.

limitations: The cascade keeps each caller-specified item indivisible. If no one font satisfies that item it returns unresolved; it does not yet discover smaller safe font-switch regions.
Grapheme alignment is only a minimum boundary check. Script/direction/language and valid shaping-item boundaries are caller responsibilities pending the shared automatic text pipeline.
Selected means no .notdef and no unresolved cmap-14 variation evidence in this profile. It does not prove expected Emoji ZWJ presentation, correct typographic choice, or Office/WPS behavior.
GSUB-only variation selectors without cmap-14 evidence can remain unresolved. Full variation/Emoji/script policy and advanced font fidelity are still incomplete.
VerifiedFont checks resource identity, supported directory/metadata/cmap structures only, not every glyph outline or layout program, and grants no font distribution or embedding rights.
Only same-bundle-range and face bindings share Rust verification within one cascade call. General cross-request catalogs, persistent caches and C++ face/font caches are not implemented.

WASM benchmark is one warm in-memory machine run, with nine counterbalanced pairs and identical glyphs. It includes reduced uploads and resource verification, excludes I/O/rendering/paragraph work, and cannot establish general product speedup.
Native process pool, browser Worker, complete resource budgets and end-user cancellation integration remain incomplete.
No rendering/playback, advanced presentation objects, target Office/WPS acceptance, Agent distribution or Musterwork replacement gate is closed.
